---
title: Graph Links in Beads
description: Non-blocking links between issues
---
Graph links represent knowledge relationships beyond blocking dependencies. `relates-to` is a loose association, `replies-to` threads messages, `duplicate_of` identifies a canonical issue, and `superseded_by` forms version chains. These links are useful for knowledge graphs but do not make work ready or blocked. Use a specific relation when possible. See [Dependencies](/core-concepts/dependencies) for workflow-affecting edges.
